# SB-1008: Safety bulletin: arc flash at the induction power cabinet

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Hazard description
The induction power cabinet feeding the ring rolling drive has produced an arc flash event during a maintenance access sequence. The arc produced high-energy ejection of molten metal and caused electrical insulation damage inside the cabinet. There is an immediate risk of serious burn injury and secondary hazards from falling conductors and damaged control wiring. Entry into the cabinet or work on live components without established arc flash controls exposes personnel to unacceptable risk.

Affected equipment
The condition affects the induction power cabinet associated with EQ-P1-L2-RR01 and all upstream disconnects in the line P1-L2 distribution path. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm. Operators, maintenance technicians, and electricians who perform diagnostics, testing, or component replacement on this cabinet are considered potentially exposed.

Required controls
- Establish a zero-energy verification procedure and lockout/tagout before any access. Refer to SOP-P1-L2-03 for LOTO sequencing and verification steps.  
- Require arc-rated PPE and flash protection boundaries when live testing is unavoidable; consult ECN-2026-009 for approved PPE selections and cabinet repair specifications.  
- Restrict non-essential personnel from the area during troubleshooting and repairs. Document access in maintenance records and include an assigned safety observer.  
- De-energize and perform infrared and visual inspection after any arc event; follow completion steps in SOP-P1-L2-05 for post-event inspection and component replacement.  
- Suspend all ring loading and rolling operations that rely on this cabinet until repairs and verification are complete.

Effective date
Effective date: Immediate. All work on the induction power cabinet feeding EQ-P1-L2-RR01 must comply with the required controls above until engineering validation and sign-off are completed per ECN-2026-009 and SOP-P1-L2-05.
